Filed by root as a successor of #2115 (2026-10-26). Bind the #2115 LoudnessObserver at the spectrum target kinds (submix, output), so that the console can show loudness for each group bus or aux. It reuses the render observer; it needs a per-target arming in the LOUDNESS command or a target field, and a decision on how many meters a session may arm at once (memory per meter about 75 KB).
